main_text.head: ARTICULUS UNDECIMUS. De distantia Astrorum à Terra, & decorum Magnitudine.

page.notes: Large initial letters Q (Quandoquidem) and C (COEli) joined to the first word; the second word of the Coeli paragraph is set in capitals "OEli" and is transcribed as printed.
